hooks.name: obsidian-session-init
hooks.command: bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; plugin_root="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${extensionPath:-}}}"; if [ -n "$plugin_root" ] && [ -f "$plugin_root/scripts/session-init.sh" ]; then exec bash "$plugin_root/scripts/session-init.sh"; fi; if [ -f "scripts/session-init.sh" ]; then exec bash "scripts/session-init.sh"; fi; echo "Obsidian session-init hook could not find the plugin root. Set CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, PLUGIN_ROOT, or extensionPath, or run the hook from the plugin root." >&2; exit 1'
hooks.description: Reports vault status and refreshes the RAG index when a session starts.
